name: Krish Rathi - Job Hunter - Free Ready

parameters.content:
# Free Job Hunter Setup
1. Create one Google Gemini credential and select it on both Gemini nodes.
2. Create one Telegram credential with your bot token and select it on the Telegram Trigger and both Send Message nodes.
3. Activate the workflow.
4. Send `/jobs` to the bot once. The bot stores your chat ID automatically and replies with ranked jobs.
5. The daily trigger will reuse the stored chat ID at 9:00 AM.

No paid job API is used. Public sources: Remotive, Unstop, Arbeitnow, RemoteOK, Himalayas, and The Muse.

// The first /jobs message stores the Telegram chat ID for later manual and scheduled runs.
const incoming = $input.first().json || {};
const workflowState = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
const incomingChatId =
  incoming.message?.chat?.id ||
  incoming.callback_query?.message?.chat?.id ||
  '';

if (incomingChatId) {
  workflowState.telegramChatId = String(incomingChatId);
}

return [{
  json: {
    resumeText,
    userPreferences,
    telegramChatId: String(incomingChatId || workflowState.telegramChatId || '5513468743'),
    requestId: 'job-hunt-' + Date.now(),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];

Resume:
{{ $json.resumeText }}

Return:
{
  "candidate": { "name": "", "email": "", "phone": "", "location": "", "linkedin_url": "", "github_url": "" },
  "professional": { "current_title": "", "seniority": "", "years_experience": 0, "industry": "", "domain": "" },
  "skills": { "technical": [], "soft": [], "tools": [], "certifications": [], "languages_spoken": [] },
  "education": { "degree": "", "field": "", "university": "", "graduation_year": null },
  "work_history": [{ "company": "", "role": "", "duration": "", "highlights": [] }],
  "search": { "suggested_titles": [], "keywords": [], "salary_range": { "min": null, "max": null, "currency": "INR" }, "remote_score": 0 },
  "projects": [{ "name": "", "description": "", "tech_stack": [], "impact": "" }]
}

You are a career matching assistant for an early-career software engineer.
Score every job against the candidate profile. Keep the response compact.
Return ONLY valid JSON without markdown.

Candidate:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.resumeData) }}

Jobs:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.aggregatedJobs.map(j => ({
  id: j.id,
  title: j.title,
  company: j.company,
  platform: j.platform,
  location: j.location,
  description: (j.description || '').substring(0, 350),
